clauses.title: 1. Mga Partido ug Paupahan (Parties & Premises)
clauses.english: This residential lease agreement is made between Engr. Roberto M. Tan (Lessor) and {{tenant_name}} (Lessee) for the leased unit {{unit}} located at {{property_address}}.
clauses.bisaya: Kini nga kasulatan sa pag-abang gikasabutan tali ni Engr. Roberto M. Tan (Tigpaabang) ug {{tenant_name}} (Nag-abang) alang sa unit {{unit}} nga nahimutang sa {{property_address}}.
clauses.text: This residential lease agreement is made between Engr. Roberto M. Tan (Lessor) and {{tenant_name}} (Lessee) for the leased unit {{unit}} located at {{property_address}}.

clauses.title: 2. Abang ug Adlaw sa Pagbayad (Rent & Due Date)
clauses.english: The monthly rental rate is {{rent}}, strictly due and payable on or before the {{due_day}} day of each calendar month without need of demand.
clauses.bisaya: Ang binuwan nga abang nagkantidad og {{rent}}, nga kinahanglang bayran sa o sa dili pa ang ika-{{due_day}} nga adlaw sa matag bulan nga walay langan.
clauses.text: The monthly rental rate is {{rent}}, strictly due and payable on or before the {{due_day}} day of each calendar month without need of demand.

clauses.title: 3. Seguridad Deposit ug Advance (Security Deposit & Advance)
clauses.english: The Lessee pays an advance rent of {{advance}} and a security deposit of {{deposit}} to answer for unpaid bills or damages beyond normal wear and tear.
clauses.bisaya: Ang Nag-abang mobayad og advance nga {{advance}} ug security deposit nga {{deposit}} aron pagsigurado sa bisan unsang wala mabayri nga bayronon o kadaot.
clauses.text: The Lessee pays an advance rent of {{advance}} and a security deposit of {{deposit}} to answer for unpaid bills or damages beyond normal wear and tear.

clauses.title: 4. Panahon sa Pag-abang (Lease Term)
clauses.english: The lease commences on 2026-11-01 for an initial duration of {{lease_duration}}, renewable upon mutual written agreement of both parties.
clauses.bisaya: Ang pag-abang magsugod sa 2026-11-01 sulod sa gidugayon nga {{lease_duration}}, ug mahimong bag-ohon pinaagi sa sinulat nga kasabutan.
clauses.text: The lease commences on 2026-11-01 for an initial duration of {{lease_duration}}, renewable upon mutual written agreement of both parties.

clauses.title: 5. Mga Serbisyo ug Bayronon (Utilities Arrangement)
clauses.english: Electricity utility arrangement: sub-metered billing based on official kilowatt consumption. Water is shared equally among residents.
clauses.bisaya: Ang kuryente gibase sa sub-meter subay sa nakunsumong kilowatt. Ang bayronon sa tubig pagabahinon sa tanang residente sa paupahan.
clauses.text: Electricity utility arrangement: sub-metered billing based on official kilowatt consumption. Water is shared equally among residents.

clauses.title: 6. Kalinaw ug Alituntunin (House Rules & Peaceful Living)
clauses.english: Quiet hours begin promptly at 10:00 PM daily. Hallways and shared facilities must be kept clean. Unauthorized subleasing is strictly prohibited.
clauses.bisaya: Magsugod ang ting-hilom sa 10:00 PM matag gabii. Kinahanglang limpyo ang agianan ug kasilyas. Hugot nga gidili ang pagpasulod og sub-lessee.
clauses.text: Quiet hours begin promptly at 10:00 PM daily. Hallways and shared facilities must be kept clean. Unauthorized subleasing is strictly prohibited.

clauses.title: 7. Pagbiya ug Pahibalo (Move-Out Notice)
clauses.english: Either party may terminate this agreement by providing at least 30 days prior written notice in accordance with Philippine tenancy laws.
clauses.bisaya: Bisan kinsa sa duha ka partido mahimong mopaundang niini nga kasabutan pinaagi sa paghatag og 30 ka adlaw nga abanteng sinulat nga pahibalo.
clauses.text: Either party may terminate this agreement by providing at least 30 days prior written notice in accordance with Philippine tenancy laws.

clauses.text: Electricity utility arrangement: sub-metered billing based on official kilowatt consumption. Water is shared equally among residents.

clauses.title: 6. Kalinaw ug Alituntunin (House Rules & Peaceful Living)
clauses.english: Quiet hours begin promptly at 10:00 PM daily. Hallways and shared facilities must be kept clean. Unauthorized subleasing is strictly prohibited.
clauses.bisaya: Magsugod ang ting-hilom sa 10:00 PM matag gabii. Kinahanglang limpyo ang agianan ug kasilyas. Hugot nga gidili ang pagpasulod og sub-lessee.
clauses.text: Quiet hours begin promptly at 10:00 PM daily. Hallways and shared facilities must be kept clean. Unauthorized subleasing is strictly prohibited.

clauses.title: 7. Pagbiya ug Pahibalo (Move-Out Notice)
clauses.english: Either party may terminate this agreement by providing at least 30 days prior written notice in accordance with Philippine tenancy laws.
clauses.bisaya: Bisan kinsa sa duha ka partido mahimong mopaundang niini nga kasabutan pinaagi sa paghatag og 30 ka adlaw nga abanteng sinulat nga pahibalo.
clauses.text: Either party may terminate this agreement by providing at least 30 days prior written notice in accordance with Philippine tenancy laws.
